newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Rabo in Russian food-agribusiness venture.
newsitem.headline: Rabo in Russian food-agribusiness venture.

text.p: Dutch cooperative Rabobank Nederland said on Friday its consultancy unit Rural Investment Advisory Services (RIAS) had set up a joint venture with Russia's Agroprombank and Interagrofond.
The Moscow-based combination will advise on privatisation and restructuring in the Russian food and agribusiness sectors and will be managed by Rabobank.
The unlisted Dutch bank said the as yet unnamed joint venture would combine the local knowhow of Agroprombank, Interagrofond's investment strength and Rabobank's international expertise.

Agroprombank would use its nationwide network of offices to promote the advisory services offered by the new unit and Interagrofond will act as a link between the joint venture and its investment projects.
The new combine would use Rabobank's worldwide network to offer its services to non-Russian clients looking to do business in Russia, the Dutch bank added.
No financial details of the new joint venture were given.
